## Geometry and neighborhoods

Planned: PCA, t-SNE, UMAP, k-nearest neighbors, k-means, and hierarchical clustering.

### Database sequence search

- [BLAST seed-and-extend search](algorithms/blast-seed-and-extend-search.qmd): word seeds, candidate extension, HSPs, and E-value interpretation
- [FASTA sequence-search algorithm](algorithms/fasta-sequence-search-algorithm.qmd): diagonal word clustering and staged local-alignment refinement

### k-mer representations and sketches

- [k-mers and sequence composition](algorithms/k-mers-and-sequence-composition.qmd): sequence words, counting, spectra, and the specificity--robustness trade-off
- [Minimizers and sequence sketching](algorithms/minimizers-and-sequence-sketching.qmd): sparse local seeds for scalable sequence indexing, mapping, and assembly

### Genome assembly graphs

- [de Bruijn graphs for genome assembly](algorithms/de-bruijn-graphs-for-genome-assembly.qmd): k-mer overlap graphs, unitigs, graph simplification, and repeat ambiguity
- [Overlap--layout--consensus assembly](algorithms/overlap-layout-consensus-assembly.qmd): explicit read overlaps, graph layout, consensus polishing, and long-read assembly

### Compressed sequence indexes

- [Burrows--Wheeler transform](algorithms/burrows-wheeler-transform.qmd): reversible sequence reordering, LF mapping, and context clustering
- [FM-index for sequence search](algorithms/fm-index-for-sequence-search.qmd): backward search, rank queries, and compact exact reference lookup
- [Suffix trees and suffix arrays](algorithms/suffix-trees-and-suffix-arrays.qmd): lexicographic full-text indexes for exact matches, repeats, and shared substrings
- [Hash-based sequence indexing](algorithms/hash-based-sequence-indexing.qmd): k-mer lookup tables for seed retrieval and candidate generation

### Read mapping and placement confidence

- [Read mapping and seed chaining](algorithms/read-mapping-and-seed-chaining.qmd): sparse anchors, collinear chains, and local alignment of candidate loci
- [Mapping quality estimation](algorithms/mapping-quality-estimation.qmd): Phred-scaled placement confidence, competitor alignments, and SAM/BAM interpretation

### Hidden Markov models for sequences

- [Pairwise hidden Markov models](algorithms/pairwise-hidden-markov-models.qmd): probabilistic match/gap paths, Viterbi decoding, likelihoods, and alignment uncertainty
- [Profile HMMs for protein families](algorithms/profile-hidden-markov-models-for-protein-families.qmd): position-specific family models for domain detection, alignment, and remote-homology search

## Graphs and optimization

Planned: Louvain, Leiden, dynamic programming, integer linear programming, minimum spanning trees, and neighbor joining.

## Sequence and probabilistic models

Planned: hidden Markov models, MCMC, and Bayesian inference.

### Pairwise sequence alignment

- [Global sequence alignment: Needleman–Wunsch](algorithms/needleman-wunsch-global-alignment.qmd): optimal end-to-end alignment, scoring, traceback, affine gaps, and interpretation
- [Local sequence alignment: Smith–Waterman](algorithms/smith-waterman-local-alignment.qmd): optimal subsequence alignment, local restart, statistical meaning, and practical diagnostics
